[Erowid Note: 
Some medications contain acetaminophen/paracetamol in combination with other drugs. When taking large amounts of those mixed medications, the amount of acetaminophen can become toxic to the liver. Deaths have been reported at 10 grams of acetaminophen and accidental acetaminophen over dose is a cause of liver failure. Maximum recommended daily dosage is 4 grams. People with liver disease or regular users of other liver-loads such as alcohol should probably use less than 4 grams per day.]
Although the FDA is now limiting the number of pills alloted to each pharmacy, Houston Texas is a known hydrocodone lovers paradise - sorry, no Oxycodone. We've got people coming from other states to stock up on these drugs. Pain clinics are everywhere. Most charge $70 for a script of 120 hydrocodone (you choose the variety - 10/325, 10/500, 10/650, etc.), 90 - 120 Soma, and 30 - 60 Xanax. After that it's typically between $90 - to $200 to get the scripts filled at these shady pharmacies - you don't go to Walgreen's. There are no doctor shopping laws in Texas and the independent pharmacies are not linked, so basically you can hit up as many clinics/pharmacies as you want as long as you wait 30 days before using the same clinic/pharmacy.
I usual dose take 100mg (10 Norco) and 1625mg (5 Soma) at a time - two to three times a day. Today, I've taken 300mg hydro and 4875mg Soma with the last dose being about 1.5 hours ago. The bulk of the effects last about four hours. Mood, energy, and motivation are greatly increased making them great for work. I'm normally a pretty shy person, but on these meds, I'm quite outgoing and sociable. They also make everyday tasks much more enjoyable - I'll happily clean my house, wash the car, and mow the lawn on any given Sunday - not something I'd do were I not high on opiates.
Physical side effects are generally mild, but include urine retention, raised body temperature, impotence, constipation, and for some odd reason acne. These usually clear up in 5 - 10 days.
Please don't forget that all the different flavors of 'Vicodin' contain varying amounts of acetaminophen (Tylenol). Anything over 4 grams of Tylenol in a 24 hour period is dangerous to you liver. I've been (greatly) exceeding this amount for years, but get liver profile blood work done a couple times per year and so far, so good. I'm just lucky in that regard. I know a number of people on these drugs that have permanently damaged their livers, but are addicts and continue to use. Whatever you do, stick with Norco - each tablet contains 10mg hydrocodone and 325mg Tylenol - the lowest amount of Tylenol in any of the typical hydro/apap preparations.
After doing this consistently for so long, I'm a true addict. The withdrawals start about 12 hours after the last good dose. Symptoms include extreme lethargy, depression, diarrhea, night sweats, and moderate to extreme insomnia. Aside from the physical symptoms, I estimate that I've blown about $20,000 on my habit the past 2.5 years.
Enjoy, but please be careful and responsible.
